en.headline: Showers and squally thunderstorms expected over parts of Hong Kong this morning
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said areas of thunderstorms near the Pearl River Estuary are expected to bring heavier rain and strong gusts to parts of the territory in the next few hours.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued a special weather tip early on Saturday indicating that thunderstorms near the Pearl River Estuary continued to develop and that parts of Hong Kong could see heavier rain and squally thunderstorms over the next few hours.
In a related gust forecast, the Observatory advised the public to stay alert as strong gusts of 70 kilometres per hour or more could affect the territory.

The nine-day forecast described Saturday as mainly cloudy with a few showers, heavier in some areas with squally thunderstorms at first, followed by sunny intervals during the day. Temperatures were expected to range from 27 to 32 degrees Celsius.

zh.headline: 本港今早部分地區預料有較大雨勢及狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台表示珠江口一帶持續有雷雨區發展，未來數小時本港部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴，市民請留意天氣變化。
body: 香港天文台周六凌晨發出特別天氣提示，指珠江口一帶持續有雷雨區發展，預料未來數小時本港部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴。
天文台同時發出陣風預報，提醒市民提高警惕，預料高達每小時70公里或以上的強陣風吹襲香港。
九天天氣預報顯示，周六大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨，初時部分地區驟雨較多及有雷暴，日間短暫時間有陽光，氣溫介乎27至32度。
